conditions.correct_source_control: fitted source model without deployment distortion
conditions.local_scene_fold: absolute-log fold around hazard 0.12 for scene=busy only
conditions.local_subject_saturation: monotone tanh compression in log risk for subject=cup only
conditions.local_subject_scene_bump: smooth Gaussian log-risk bump for subject=cup and scene=busy only

protocol.hidden_truth_boundary: clean calibration labels are used only for the named oracle and decoder error audit; candidate decoding receives repeated labels only
protocol.noise_assumption: homogeneous symmetric conditionally independent annotator flips; rate estimated from calibration pairwise disagreement
protocol.split: outcome-independent nested calibration and identity-disjoint fixed test; gate discovery and confirmation are identity-disjoint
